For comparison the same call on main's 10fc3b77a13e returns several `github-actions` suites, so the absence is this branch's, not the repository's. The cause is failure 1: `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` runs on `pull_request: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review]`, and GitHub computes no merge ref for a conflicting head and starts no run on it, so every push to this branch since the pull request opened has started nothing. I did not re-run any lane myself and did not wait for one: a tester reads CI on GitHub, and there is nothing there to read. This is not evidence of a code defect; it is the absence of the whole static half of the gate. Remedy: the forward merge of failure 1 makes the head mergeable, which lets the `synchronize` event start the router; read `ci-ok` at that head.
